shape: verifier and builder in parallel, verifier sends findings to the builder and the pilot; pilot verifies and commits; fit-critic and trim-critic over the finished change; team dispatch quiet mode
scope: body-builder writes only: team/officers/pilot/pilot.md, job.md, identity.md, README.md in that folder; base/bin/pilot.sh; base/bin/session-start.sh; base/settings/pilot.settings.json; base/verify/lint.yaml; base/README.md; CLAUDE.md; records/manuals/claude-code/settings-and-launch.md only where it names the persona files; its report under records/notepad/agent-body-2026-09-20/. docs-verifier writes only its report there. No commits by crew.
outcome: The agent body landed in one revertible commit, 8a05299, from restore point e2cd9db. team/officers/pilot/pilot.md is the agent definition and the single source for model and effort; pilot.sh builds the --agents JSON from it and passes --agents, --agent pilot and --effort on start and resume, appending identity.md and commander.md and no longer job.md; the settings file carries neither model nor effort; the hook no longer tells the session to follow a procedure; CLAUDE.md keeps rules of the place, with rules 5, 10, 12 and crew protocol 4 to 7 as numbered pointers; lint excludes pilot.md. Five builder passes. Verified by the pilot: byte comparison of the JSON prompt with the file body, --check on start and resume, --agents-json alone, full lint clean, and headless launches read from output fields and transcripts. Left for the commander's next shift: the session opens logged on; a teammate does not inherit the body; what initialPrompt does on resume. Open: WS028, the launch manual lines, folding identity.md and commander.md into the body (Or064).
lessons: measure before ruling: the pilot twice sent the builder a harness claim as settled (effort fallback; CLAUDE.md not auto-loading) and both were wrong or incomplete; two of the five passes were the pilot's own reversals
a headless launch with a harmless copy of the definition, no tools, read from modelUsage and the transcript's effort field, settled four harness questions in minutes that the docs leave open
critics reading while the builder is still moving produce findings against a superseded state; freeze the build before the critics start, as P002 step 3 says for papers
ask what a file is for before trimming it: deduplicating pilot.md against identity.md and commander.md was correct for today's prompt and wrong for the commander's intention that the body stand alone
the builder tested the branch it could have assumed (no effort key under set -e) and corrected its own earlier explanation of the lint fault unprompted
